finish_message: Phase 5 flashcard SRS review mode, deep linking, card link copying, and Anki TSV export are complete and pushed.
summary: Added cloze masking/reveal parsing, SRS due-card queries and review recording, a full flashcard review UI with grading shortcuts and session summary, margin-graph deep-link parsing/generation and app routing, copy-deep-link actions on MindMap/Outline cards, Anki TSV export, due-card toolbar integration, and automated Phase 5 tests. Also changed topic updates to SQL UPDATE so attaching study-set documents does not cascade-delete existing cards.
notes: The implementation targets macOS SwiftUI/AppKit/PDFKit. The available execution environment here does not provide the macOS SDK, so swift test and swift build were not run locally; the orchestrator should run both validation commands on macOS.
